with open("secretMessage.enc","rb") as enc, open("secretMessage.raw","wb") as raw:
    init = enc.read(1)
    raw.write(init)
    while (byte := enc.read(1)) != b'':
        if (init == byte):
            cycle = int.from_bytes(enc.read(1))
            raw.write((cycle+1)*byte)
            init = byte
        else:
            raw.write(byte)
            init = byte
